name: Invasion Tree
description: The Invasion Tree is the Phyrexian tree whose branches burst through portals to attack many planes during the March of the Machine.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
timeline.quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
timeline.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn tells the Mirrans that they will be freed of their skin's treachery; Elspeth reaches for her sword.
timeline.quote: Elspeth reaches for her sword.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
timeline.quote: Killing her will not end this.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
timeline.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
timeline.quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Serra she is afraid, and Serra embraces her, tells her fear is last to leave and remakes her.
timeline.quote: "Fear is always the last thing to leave,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
timeline.quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: An angel in gleaming armor, a golden blade now raised to counter Jin-Gitaxias's strike.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
timeline.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian ranks falter and Koth, healed, calls magma and rallies the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "Mirrodin!" says Koth. "With me!"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn grabs Jin-Gitaxias by the throat when he suggests retreating, then orders him and Nissa to deal with the prisoners.
timeline.quote: "Dissent is a blasphemy, praetor .

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn, who can no longer walk, asks Chandra to carry her toward the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: She scoops Wrenn up.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira frees Karn's platform and Koth uses stone to bring Karn along with the fleeing group.
timeline.quote: Karn's slab flies out to meet them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa pursues the fleeing group, flinging bodies at them and threatening to kill Chandra unless she drops Wrenn.
timeline.quote: "Drop the dryad and there's still hope for you, Chandra.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn pulls Elspeth from the air and builds new armor from fallen Phyrexians, while Elspeth burns it with a beam from Godsend.
timeline.quote: A little focus is all it takes to send a searing beam of light at Norn.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn raises walls to block Elspeth and tries to persuade her that her wings make her a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: What does this form offer you that Phyrexia cannot?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
timeline.quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn tears off Jin-Gitaxias's arm for suggesting she compleat Elspeth, and Elspeth stabs Norn's shoulder, making her bleed and escaping her grip.
timeline.quote: She drives her sword into Norn's wounded shoulder

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira is struck down by Phyrexian spears on the bridge as Koth screams.
timeline.quote: That person crumpling to the ground—is that Melira?

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth argues that Norn wants worship for herself, not Phyrexia, enraging Norn who hurls blades.
timeline.quote: Power's the only thing you care about.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
timeline.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 7: Divine Intervention" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa's barbed vine goes through Melira's stomach and attacks Chandra and Wrenn.
timeline.quote: the other end of the tendril's gone clean through Melira's stomach.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: Nissa lifting her by the ankle with a long and brassy root.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nissa strangles Chandra with vines while Melira helps Wrenn up to the observation platform.
timeline.quote: Vines wrap about Chandra's throat.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: magic ebbs from Melira's hand, glowing a faint white.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: Wrenn begins to sing.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A golden angel strikes Nissa with light, forcing her to drop Chandra, whom the angel sets on the platform.
timeline.quote: the angel catches Chandra and sets her on the platform.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: Flaming trees grow to the size of mountains

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Eight grows tall, and Wrenn names him Eight and resolves to bring him to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Hello, Eight , she says. Let's introduce you to Teferi.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: Even smaller when his own creations start eating him.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: "Clear a path for the Mirrans!"

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: an acorn hidden within the ash.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.
